########
# MEG2 #
########

R functions for estimation and inference under the MEG2 distribution.

This repository contains the R codes developed for the MEG2 model, including functions for evaluating the distribution, fitting the model to data, and carrying out likelihood-based inference.

## MEG2 distribution

The MEG2 model is a structured exponential-gamma mixture distribution with parameter-coupled mixing weights. It provides a flexible family for modelling positive-valued data.

## Distribution functions

The file "RC01_MEG2_Functions.R" contains the main functions associated with the MEG2 distribution. In particular, it provides functions for:

- evaluating the probability density function (PDF);
- evaluating the cumulative distribution function (CDF);
- calculating quantiles of the MEG2 distribution;
- generating random observations from the MEG2 distribution.

These functions provide the basic computational tools used by the remaining codes in the repository.

## Model fitting and inference

The file "RC02_MEG2_Fit_Functions_C.R" contains the main functions for fitting the MEG2 model to a data set and performing the associated inferential and goodness-of-fit procedures. In particular, it provides functions for:

- Newton--Raphson (NR) estimation;
- Newton--GEM (NGEM) estimation;
- Wald confidence intervals;
- likelihood-ratio (LR) confidence intervals;
- goodness-of-fit (GOF) measures;
- graphical representations of the fitted model.

## Manuscript

The codes are associated with the manuscript:

"A structured exponential-gamma mixture family with parameter-coupled weights: theory and likelihood-based inference"
